The inspector needs another round: the verdict is **fix**, with six fixes and five notes. The full review is in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-page-design/inspector/review.md`.

**What works:**
- Both new views exist: one shows what a page is made of, the other replays its history with a slider.
- The settings page loads them only when it opens, so the rest of `/live/` pays nothing for them.
- The replay never writes anything to disk.
- The node test passes in 0.13 s, according to the worker's proof file.

**What must change:**
1. **No styling.** No CSS matches the new sections. On the page, each row's class name runs straight into its title ("SettingsLivePage"). The rows sit on bare background while the file list above them sits in white cards. "WHAT IT IS MADE OF" and "INSIDE" stack as two identical headings.
2. **The history summary shows only counts** ("content: 11"). The brief asked for the title, each card in order, and the sub-pages at each slider position.
3. **The proof screenshots don't show the slider.** All four are the top of the screen only, so the methods, the fields and the slider at line 1 and at the last line never appear.
4. **The new module isn't listed** in `ext/readme.md`'s index, which lists every other ext module.
5. **The method-listing code is now written twice:** once in `ItemInspector.js` and once in `MethodMap.js`. The brief allowed moving it into the new module and having `MethodMap.js` import it.
6. **Heading cards show only their id**, because the code reads `title` and headings keep their words in `text`.

**Worth a look:**
- Internal lists show up in the inspector (`_pages`, `removed (15)`).
- The full list of history lines has no scroll limit.
- The replay always rebuilds as a plain Page, even when the page is a LivePage or DesignPage.
- There is no demo page for the new module.

There were no screenshots in a shots folder, so I judged from the worker's own screenshots at 400 and 1200 in the `pd-inspect` worktree.

I've reviewed the Inspect work (round 2): it needs one fix, and I have six smaller notes. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-page-design/inspector/review/report.md`.

**Verdict:** fix. All six numbered asks in the brief are met.

**The fix:** in the Fields section, the name "description" breaks in the middle of the word: "descriptio / n" at 1200 and "descr / iption" at 400. The style that lets each row wrap anywhere also breaks the field name. Keeping the name on one line and letting only the value wrap would fix it.

**Notes:**
- **Files outside its allowed list:** the branch includes about 30 generated `files.jsonl` index files and two lines in `public/live/page.jsonl`. They came from a "wip" commit that picked up other agents' changes before the merge, so check that the merge doesn't duplicate lines in those logs.
- **Line counts disagree:** the settings page says "Lines 13", but the slider on the same page reaches "line 14 of 14".
- **The list appears twice:** with the slider at the last line, "How it got here" repeats the "Inside" list row for row (11 cards), which roughly doubles the page.
- **Stacked headings:** "What it is made of" still sits directly on "Inside", which the first review already flagged.
- **Doc page:** the Inspect page opens on one link card and 84% empty space, and the slider view has no demo at all.
- **Methods:** it lists every method a class has (Page alone has 107), not only the ones a delta can call. The module's readme already says so.

**What I looked at:** the review screenshots covered `/framework/ext/Inspect/` and `/live/` at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440. Neither of those is the settings page this change adds to, so I also used the worker's own full-height screenshots of the settings pages at 400 and 1200.

**Docs:** nothing is missing from an index and nothing is out of date. A fresh agent could continue from the task folder: `requirements.md`, the first round's `review.md`, and `proof.md` with its list of commits.
